exit 1
Usage: <exe> patch <input.iso|input.ciso|input.rvz> [output.iso]
  Default output: <input>-multiplayer.iso (next to the input)
  An .rvz, .wia or .gcz is converted to a temporary ISO first, with the DolphinTool
  next to your Dolphin (a running Dolphin's first, then DOLPHIN_EXE's, then the usual places)
